name: Paperlight
thesis: Otium feels like a small stack of carefully chosen reading cards, with the composure of a native app and the warmth of paper held in your hand.
difference: Centered Newsreader headlines and serif navigation sit on warm ivory; a gently rotated, white-rimmed photograph supplies the tactile note, while sage session controls and a floating four-place dock keep interaction familiar and quiet.
tradeoff: The persistent dock makes every destination easy to find but leaves less room for the story than a fully immersive session.
lens: An Apple-platform product designer translating native ease and polish into an analog, serif-led reading ritual.
